about: Kamelia (Mia) Poppe is the principal attorney at The Law Firm of Poppe & Associates, PLLC, with office in New York City, New York. Her legal practice is exclusively dedicated to family and divorce law, where she has gained significant experience in various areas, including:
Ms. Poppe serves clients across a broad geographical range, including Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Westchester County, Nassau County, Suffolk County and Riverdale.

Ms. Poppe's journey into the legal profession began with her impressive academic achievements. She graduated magna cum laude with a Juris Doctorate degree from North Carolina Central University School of Law after earning her B.S. from the College of Charleston in 1986. During her law school years, she held the esteemed position of law journal editor and continues to contribute her legal insights through commentary, particularly in the realms of corporate and business law.

What sets Ms. Poppe apart is her unique blend of legal prowess and extensive experience as a senior business leader at prominent organizations such as Citicorp, General Electric and Bank of America, accumulating over 22 years of invaluable business acumen. She provides comprehensive and strategic guidance to her clients, facilitating their legal needs while navigating the intricacies of business practices.

Ms. Poppe's approach to her clients' cases is marked by a commitment to keeping a level head, offering sage counsel, and providing much-needed mental and emotional support as they embark on the next chapter of their lives.

Beyond her legal practice, Ms. Poppe actively participates in various professional associations, including the Association of the Bar of the City of New York, the New York State Bar Association, the American Bar Association, the Brooklyn Bar Association and the New York County Lawyers Association. Her legal acumen and dedication to her clients have earned her recognition, including the Avvo Clients' Choice Award in 2022, alongside a "Superb" rating.
Ms. Poppe's involvement extends to pro bono activities, where she is a member of the Montclair Writers Group, part of the New York Road Runners club and the Lincoln Center Kids Steering Committee.
